Absolute continuity gives the last integral o(1),not the rate needed to cancel rho^-8/7. For a core of massnu,widthepsilon,hatf_i(s,x)=epsilon³/nu f_i(t0+(epsilon³/nu)s,u+epsilon x) satisfies intD(hatf)ds=(1/nu)intD(f)dt.
